title: Lane lint runs every check the checks job runs on the lane's changed files
why: Coordinator 21:13 CST Nov 8: batch 67 (now #2369, batch-67c, 29 lanes) dropped #1572 for narration comments that the checks job caught (lint/check_comment_narration.py), not the lane lint. A lane red like this must be caught before the batch.
note: Triage read of main 21:13 CST: lane lint already lists this check. bin/ci-job is_lint() takes a step whose run lines match LINT_CMD, and `python3 lint/check_comment_narration.py --base "origin/$BASE_REF"` matches; its `if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'` reads true when pr is set. So the likely cause is that #1572's lane skipped `merge --lane-lint`, or ran it on an older head. First step: read #1572's lane report or ledger for a lane-lint run at its final head. If it ran there and passed, the gap is in ci-job; else the fix is a guard that refuses a lane's hand-off without a lane-lint pass at its head (compare step lane-lint-before-push). 21:14 CST: doing, lane session_013NEJKz3Pbvh8FJVoT2ydk8; it reports the cause first.
